title: Almost Found It
description: binary_search(items, target) returns the index of target in the sorted list items, or -1 if it isn't there.
hint: `high` is an inclusive index here. When `low == high`, is there still one item left to check?
explanation: With an inclusive `high`, the range `low..high` still holds one item when `low == high`. `while low < high` stops before checking it, so a target in the last remaining slot is missed. Use `while low <= high`. Off-by-one errors in loop bounds are the classic binary search bug.
